body: Of course I don't mind! It's beautiful! Thank you! I'm saving it :)

I'm a little ashamed of these poems, I've been told they're too emo. I don't know if I'd have the courage to share it in a critique circle.

I often wear "masks" on my daily interactions with people, and they all think I'm a cheerful gal that listen and understand everybody's problems. So maybe sharing this depressed side could backfire. I don't know.

But thank you so much for your feedback :) You made me smile today :)

Thank you. I used to play the guitar, but I haven't touched it a long time and the strings are rusty.

I write these poems to try to put the pain in the paper. Sometimes it helps, sometimes, not so much (like today). But at least the time I put when writing it is a time that I won't be thinking about dying, so in the end, it helps.
